facts.claim: For 2026 the tourist tax in the City of Dubrovnik is EUR 2.65 per person per night from 1 April to 30 September and EUR 1.85 in the rest of the year at accommodation where catering is provided (campsites EUR 1.95 and EUR 1.30), set by the Dubrovnik-Neretva County Assembly under article 15 of the Tourist Tax Act.

sources.title: Dubrovnik-Neretva County Assembly: decision on the amount of the tourist tax for 2026 (adopted 13 December 2024)

facts.claim: Under the Tourist Tax Act (NN 52/19) children under 12 do not pay the tourist tax (article 5) and persons aged 12 to 18 pay it reduced by 50% (article 6); the tax is per person and night.

facts.claim: The Platanus shuttle from the airport stops at the Old Town (Ploče Gate), about 30 minutes, then the main bus station in Gruž, about 35 minutes (final stop), 500 m from the ferry port; it lists no stop at Pile.

facts.claim: The City of Dubrovnik's decision on vehicle access to the traffic zone in the protected historic ensemble applies the system from 1 March to 30 November (extendable by the mayor in congestion); vehicle access is by pass; the lower cable car station is at Ploče; Adriatic Luxury Hotels' notice dated 30 July 2026 says vehicle access around the Old Town is restricted to permit holders only.
